sql:
with t as (select o.market_ticker, string_agg(distinct o.strategy, '+') tags from live_orders o join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy in ('Fmmsell10','Hmmsell10','Jmmsell10') and o.action='buy' group by 1),
s as (select distinct on (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker, coalesce(p.quantity_fp,p.quantity::numeric) q, p.realized_pnl r, p.avg_price a from positions p join t using(market_ticker) order by p.market_ticker, p.captured_at desc),
m as (select distinct on (k.market_ticker) k.market_ticker, k.no_bid from mmsell_position_ticks k join t using(market_ticker) where k.no_bid is not null order by k.market_ticker, k.captured_at desc),
x as (select t.market_ticker, t.tags, split_part(t.market_ticker,'-',1) series, s.q,
  case when s.q=0 then s.r else abs(s.q)*(m.no_bid - s.a)/100 end pnl from t join s using(market_ticker) left join m using(market_ticker))
select 'SERIES' k, series name, count(*) n, sum(case when pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) losers, round(sum(pnl),2) pnl, string_agg(distinct tags, ',') tags from x group by series having sum(pnl) < 0
union all
select 'MARKET', market_ticker, 1, case when pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end, round(pnl,2), tags || case when q<>0 then ' (open)' else '' end from x where pnl < -0.5
order by 1 desc, 5 asc limit 40
